title: Speech
description: The result of synthesizing one NPC utterance: the clean spoken text (emotion tags stripped out into `emotions`), the emotion cues, and an optional audio handle. `audio` is null when no TTS provider is wired, so the caller degrades to text-only (no local codec sidecar, unlike gamentic).

text.description: The spoken line with recognized emotion tags removed.

emotions.description: Emotion cues parsed out of the utterance, in order (empty means neutral delivery).

audio.description: A provider-returned audio handle (url/ref/format/duration), or null when synthesis was skipped.
